messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration achieving the maximum minimum triangle area for 13 points in the unit square places the 13 points on a hexagonal-triangular lattice: the 12 vertices of a regular hexagonal arrangement at normalized positions plus the center point, scaled to fit the unit square. This configuration achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/72, as the smallest triangles formed are the elementary equilateral triangles of the hexagonal lattice, and no perturbation of any single point can increase this minimum without creating a smaller triangle elsewhere."}
